description: This file defines the main App component for a React application, including a custom hook to detect viewport size and a conditional overlay component that blocks access on non-desktop viewports. It manages routing via AppRoutes and displays a desktop-only notice when appropriate.

methods.name: useIsBelowDesktopBreakpoint
methods.description: Custom React hook that detects if the current viewport width is below a specified breakpoint (default 1024px), updating reactively on window resize.

methods.name: DesktopOnlyOverlay
methods.description: React functional component that renders an overlay informing the user that the application requires a desktop environment.

methods.name: App
methods.description: Main application component that conditionally renders either the desktop-only overlay or the application's routes based on viewport size.
